README: Baked look for one map (modules/gfxlook.js). Engine-neutral: lightmap = linear diffuse light for a white surface (png stores sqrt(light/scale); the EXR in render/look/src is the same in float), UV2 per receiver vertex in mesh order; decals = [cell, x, y, z, nx, ny, nz, width, height, rotation(rad), strength] in metres (y up), multiply blend; LUT = 32^3 (.cube + strip). See docs/agents/LOOK.md.

colourScript.README: research #2: one key + one fill + one accent family per map; mids desaturated so neon and team colours pop
colourScript.key: sodium amber lamps + red-orange port glow
colourScript.accent: cyan + magenta neon, brand colours on cargo
colourScript.values: 3 bands: night ground (dark), lit walls (mid), neon + windows (bright)

light.README: runtime light balance while the look is on (gfxlook applyLight): rim = player rim base colour (gfxmat setRimBase, yard: port glow), moon = the dynamic sun (dir TO the light), hemi = sky fill for unbaked objects (players, props), flood = corner tower lamp lens / cone / glow sprite / old additive pool colours

emissive.README: per-family emissive multipliers (yard_STYLE.md section 4): extensions multiply their own glow colours by these (ctx.D.emissive)
